entities.name: Paging Procedure
entities.description: Procedure to transmit paging information to a UE in RRC_IDLE or RRC_INACTIVE state.

entities.name: Paging
entities.description: Message sent from network to UE containing paging information.

entities.name: RRC_IDLE
entities.description: RRC state where UE is idle and not actively communicating with network.

entities.name: RRC_INACTIVE
entities.description: RRC state where UE is inactive but maintains some connection context.
